privateContract.readPortfolio: Authenticate original C08 StoredPortfolio + PortfolioBinding + historical candidates, including current case/principal/ACL, authentic selection and digest equality. This is a private host seam, not transport data.
privateContract.readMaterialChange: Compose the domain producer (PlannerMateriality or the corresponding owner) and current evidence. A componentScope carries componentId and before/after digests computed by portfolioComponentConditionDigest from actual canonical result components. Scope is checked independently; missing scope or unchanged component with a changed global comparison remains unknown.
privateContract.response: Read-only original composition/choice/ledger, per-component prepared changes and receipts, material conditions/observations/impacts, explicit unmapped or ambiguous effects; no write/apply/memory command.

patchLimit: The patch only adds private injection to the factory. WP10 must compose the authenticated reader/domain producer before enabling any route. It does not implement a public C16 operation or native/UI grant.

requiredOwnerWork.action: Compose the private historical portfolio/candidate reader using current WP11 provenance and current evidence checks; never pass a client-supplied stored object or widen native multicase scope.
Bind a materiality observation to the same source identity or an explicit published ancestry contract. A copied Planner version is not silently relabeled as the original source.
Expose authorized read-only reconciliation through installed UI/BI; preserve original values, per-change states and null/unknown disclosures.
Consume the returned condition references with originalChoice under current access. Persist memory/signals only through WP14's canonical flow; a reconciliation read is not a reconsideration command.

requiredProofs: Real same-case choice; original implementation45000 -> current70000 on the same source; original C08/choice/composition preserved
Component A affected and unchanged B not incorrectly marked material by the global comparison
Partial WP11 application and retry retains one effect/receipt; no second ledger
Revoked case/source/receipt evidence and mutation during egress return denial/stale without restricted payload
Absent injection reports unavailable; no parallel application, financial calculation or memory writer

validation.note: Owner delta only. Product checks are recorded separately against exact published WP13 SHAs.
